The lists sort, filter and search from their own column heads, one card on the Info page shows and updates everything KnightLoader is made of, and media files carry their quality in their names.

## ✨ Added

- **One Components card on the Info page.** It lists KnightLoader, GlimStone, yt-dlp, JDownloader, ffmpeg, UnRAR, Java and the built-in libraries, each with its version at the right edge, linked to its release or project page. One Check all button asks about every update at once, and a row shows a button only when there is something to do, such as an update to install.
- **Check automatically and Update automatically for KnightLoader, yt-dlp and JDownloader,** right under each name and on from the start; a choice you already saved stays. JDownloader is asked shortly after KnightLoader starts and then once a day, its row shows an update it found, and it installs that update while none of its downloads runs. A container looks for a newer KnightLoader when the card opens and leaves the update to its container manager.
- **RAR sets are unpacked with RARLAB's UnRAR,** the decoder WinRAR itself uses. The container image and the desktop app for Windows, for Linux on x86-64 and for macOS on Apple silicon bring it. Where it is missing, the built-in reader unpacks the set as before.
- **The desktop app runs JDownloader on a Java of its own.** It fetches Eclipse Temurin 21 at the first start, checks it and starts JDownloader on it, so an installed copy started from the Start menu no longer runs without JDownloader. The card shows how far the download has come, such as "Being set up · 45%", and offers Try again if it fails.
- **A Totals card beside the speed graph on Downloads.** It shows how much is loaded, how many links there are and how long the running downloads still need, and on a second line how many are done, open and failed and the average speed. The graph wears a Speed badge, and its second curve is called Upload.
- **Video and audio files carry their quality in their names, as in JDownloader:** "Title (1080p).mkv" and "Title (128kbit).m4a". The thumbnail, subtitles and description take the same name, so Plex, Jellyfin and Kodi pair them, and two picks of one video each get their own.
- **The Android app is on F-Droid.** The README, the installing page and Settings, Apps link to its listing beside the APK, with F-Droid's own logo.
- **The right-click menu reads more like JDownloader's.** In the desktop app, Open folder opens the folder a link or a package downloads into, with the file selected. Copy links, Open in browser and Set connections are new.
- **A second KnightLoader on the same computer can take Click'n'Load over.** The switch under Settings, Link collector names whoever holds the port and offers Take over. A running JDownloader is named as such.

## 🎨 Design

- **No button row above the lists.** On Downloads and in the link collector a click on a column head sorts, a second click turns the order round, the ▾ in a head filters that column, and typing or Ctrl+F searches the rows. Pause all, Resume all, Reset failed, Clean up and the rest are in the right-click on the list and in the command palette. On a phone a long press on a head offers the same.
- **The percentage sits inside the progress bar,** centred, and takes the fill's colour where the fill passes under it. The column starts wider, and a width you dragged stays.
- **The size column moved,** to the end in the link collector and just left of the progress bar on Downloads. Alt and an arrow key move a focused column head, and Reset columns brings the default order back.
- **Every button lights up under the pointer,** and every button with words has a fill.
- **The link collector ends above Start all** unless the list is long enough to scroll.
- **Options and Quick settings open under their button,** wide enough for the seven priority steps on one line.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Downloads are listed by name,** part2 before part10, and a row keeps its place while it starts, finishes or unpacks. Queue order in the sort menu shows the order the downloads run in.
- **Restart is called Reset, as in JDownloader,** and Retry failed is Reset failed.
- **Reject links already downloaded is off by default,** and a download you removed can be added again.
- **The container leaves Click'n'Load to the browser extension and the desktop app,** since no browser reaches the port inside it. With host networking, `KL_CNL` still opens it.
- **The link notices list every link they count,** and the reason gets the room it needs.
- **Statuses on the Components card are short.** An (i) stays only where something went wrong and needs you.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Install now works in the desktop app.** The card found a newer release but had nothing to press. Install now downloads the installer, checks it against the release's checksums and starts it, or puts a portable copy in place for the next start.
- **Removing or resetting a download on Windows lets go of its file.** A download removed while it was being reconnected could keep running unseen and hold its file, so Windows would not delete it.
- **Settings and sign-outs are saved on Windows while a virus scanner looks.** A scanner holding a freshly written file made saving fail with "access denied", and KnightLoader now tries again for a few seconds.
- **The Linux download buttons lead to the installers again.**

## 🔒 Security

- **The desktop app unpacks its Java runtime only into its own folder.** An entry or a link in the download that would land anywhere else stops the unpacking, and the runtime's links are written as plain copies.
- **Dependency updates close seven open advisories.** The Android app takes zod 4.6.6 and node-forge 1.4.2, and the web interface's test tooling takes undici 8.12.3.
